Translator_PluginDesc: Translate text from the search box with Microsoft Translator.
Translator_ProviderDesc: Translates text entered after its trigger word, with an optional target language code.
Translator_PlaceholderDesc: Type the optional target language code and text after the trigger word. Example: tr en hello.
Translator_LoadingDesc: Fetching a translation from Microsoft Translator.
Translator_ResultDesc: Press Enter or click to copy the translation.
Translator_FailedDesc: Microsoft Translator could not translate this text.
Translator_Config_TriggerDesc: Type this word before the optional target language code and text. Example: tr en hello. Default: tr.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_TranslationInstantProvi: Provides translations as instant answers using Microsoft Translator.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_TranslatorTranslationPr: Provides localization resources for the Translator plugin.
